privacy.s1p1: This policy describes how PitchRusch collects and uses information when you use our website and apps.
privacy.s2b1: Email address — for account creation, sign-in, security, and important service messages.
privacy.s2b2: Profile information — such as name, username, role, and details you choose to add to your profile.
privacy.s2b3: Uploaded videos and related metadata — including captions, tags, and technical data needed to store and deliver your clips.
privacy.s2p2: We may also collect limited technical data (for example device or browser type and approximate region) to keep the service secure and to improve performance.
privacy.s3p1: We use the information above to:
privacy.s3b1: Provide, maintain, and improve PitchRusch (hosting, playback, search, and features you choose to use).
privacy.s3b2: Authenticate your account, prevent abuse, and comply with legal obligations.
privacy.s3b3: Communicate with you about the service (for example security alerts or policy updates).
privacy.s4p1: We do not sell your personal data.
privacy.s4p2: We may share information with service providers who help us run the platform (for example hosting or analytics), under contracts that require them to protect your data and use it only for the services we request.

sprint20m.title: Sprint 20m Challenge
sprint20m.description: Show your speed, explosiveness, and sprint technique by running 20 meters as fast as possible.
sprint20m.rules:
Instructions:
- Mark a 20-meter distance with a start and finish line.
- Start behind the line and sprint to the finish as fast as possible.
- Record the full attempt from start to finish.

Equipment:
- 2 cones
- Phone camera
- Stopwatch
- 20 meter space

Rules:
- The player must start behind the start line.
- The sprint distance must be exactly 20 meters.
- The full attempt must be visible in the video.
- Time is measured from the first movement to crossing the finish line.
- Flying start is not allowed.
- Edited or cut videos are not allowed.
- Maximum video length is 15 seconds.

Scoring:
- Sprint time: 60
- Start explosiveness: 20
- Running technique: 10
- Execution validity: 10

Attempts:
- Free player: 1 attempt
- Premium player: multiple attempts + choose best attempt + better visibility to scouts
